caption: The drawing depicts two views of a carved owl figure, rendered in color on a light beige background. The object on the left shows a front and slightly side view of the owl, sitting atop a brown base that mimics a natural surface with green and yellow accents resembling grass or foliage. The owl itself is primarily brown with layered feather details, yellowish talons, and a prominently detailed face and eyes, including a hole in one eye, possibly for functional or decorative purposes. The object on the right is the same owl figure seen from the back, revealing more of the base which includes green and yellow highlighting at the bottom and a brown body with textured feathers. There are also visible small, circular holes on the back and side of the owl. The two views show the owl with wings pressed to its sides and perched in a lifelike manner. The artist's signature, "W. O. Fletcher," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Owl on Log Bank
